questions.question: Compare RCEP and TPP as models of multilateral economic regionalism.
questions.solution_html:
• RCEP-Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership-a trade agreement involving
  • ASEAN and its partners- including China, Japan, and South Korea- TPP -Trans-Pacific
  • Partnership- succeeded by CPTPP-Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans
  • Pacific Partnership- after the US withdrawal- promotes trade liberalisation and higher
  • standards-both encourage economic integration- but differ in membership, rules and strategic
  • orientation.

questions.question: Explain the role of education and healthcare in improving human / development in South Asia.
questions.solution_html:
• Education and healthcare are essential for human development in South Asia- education
  • improves literacy, employment opportunities, and gender equality- healthcare reduces
  • mortality, prevents diseases, and increases life expectancy-they improve living standards
  • reduce poverty, empower disadvantaged communities- contribute to sustainable economic and
  • social development.

questions.question: Explain the characteristics of authoritarian regimes in West Asia.
questions.solution_html:
• Authoritarian regimes in West Asia- characterised by concentrated political power- limited
  • political competition- restricted civil liberties- weak democratic institutions- ruling elites often
  • rely on security forces, patronage, and control over media- some regimes use religious
  • legitimacy and natural resource revenues to maintain political stability and authority.
questions.final_answer: legitimacy and natural resource revenues to maintain political stability and authority
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the major objectives of Vision 2030.
questions.solution_html:
• Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030- aims to diversify the economy beyond oil- develop the private
  • sector- attract foreign investment-promotes tourism, technology, employment and
  • entrepreneurship-other objectives -improving public services- empowering women
  • developing human capital- creating a sustainable- globally competitive economy.
questions.final_answer: developing human capital- creating a sustainable- globally competitive economy
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Analyse the role of the European Union as a model of regional integration.
questions.solution_html:
• European Union - major model of regional integration- combining economic and political
  • cooperation-its single market enables the free movement of goods, services, capital and people
  • common institutions-shared policies- the euro among participating members- strengthen
  • cooperation- differences among member states create continuing challenges.
questions.final_answer: cooperation- differences among member states create continuing challenges
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Apply the concept of the single market to explain increased competition / among firms.
questions.solution_html:
• A single market allows goods, services, capital and people to move freely among
  • participating countries-firms gain access to larger markets and more customers-they face
  • greater competition from foreign businesses-encouraging innovation- efficiency- improved
  • product quality- competitive pricing-better services for consumers.
questions.final_answer: product quality- competitive pricing-better services for consumers

questions.question: Describe the major areas covered by Area Studies.
questions.solution_html:
• Area Studies- examines the political, economic, social, cultural and historical
  • characteristics of specific geographical regions- covers international relations, languages
  • religions, geography, security, and development- combining different academic disciplines
  • helps explain regional identities-conflicts-cooperation- relationships between local societies
  • and global processes.

questions.question: Explain the role of ASEAN in promoting regional economic integration.
questions.solution_html:
• ASEAN-promotes regional economic integration- through trade liberalisation, investment
  • cooperation- ASEAN Economic Community-reduces trade barriers, encourages regional
  • supply chains- facilitates business activities-cooperation in infrastructure, tourism- digital
  • development strengthens connectivity- economic growth- Southeast Asia’s competitiveness in
  • the global economy.

questions.question: Explain the role of territorial disputes in shaping post-colonial relations in / South Asia.
questions.solution_html:
• Territorial disputes - significantly influenced post-colonial relations in South Asia
  • example-Kashmir dispute between India and Pakistan- border disagreements and conflicts over
  • territory- caused wars, military tensions and mistrust- disputes affect regional cooperation
  • defence spending-diplomatic relations-efforts to establish lasting peace and stability.
questions.final_answer: defence spending-diplomatic relations-efforts to establish lasting peace and stability
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Describe the functioning of parliamentary democracy in a South Asian / country.
questions.solution_html:
• India follows a parliamentary democratic system- based on the republican Constitution
  • President is nominal- citizens elect representatives to the Lok Sabha- Prime Minister leads the
  • government- Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha- independent
  • judiciary- regular elections- opposition parties help ensure accountability and democratic
  • governance.

questions.question: Analyse the relationship between natural resources and resource wars in / Africa.
questions.solution_html:
• Africa possesses abundant natural resources- including oil, diamonds, gold and minerals
  • competition for their control often fuels armed conflicts- corruption and political instability
  • armed groups and governments exploit resource revenues- finance wars- weak institutions and
  • inequality - poor resource management- key factors linking natural wealth to conflict.
questions.final_answer: inequality - poor resource management- key factors linking natural wealth to conflict

questions.question: Examine China’s growing political and economic influence in Central Asia.
questions.solution_html:
• China has expanded its influence in Central Asia- trade, infrastructure investment and
  • energy cooperation-Belt and Road Initiative- strengthens regional connectivity through roads
  • railways and pipelines-China also develops diplomatic and security ties with regional
  • governments- concerns about debt- economic dependence- unequal partnerships remain
  • significant challenges.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Analyse the factors responsible for military intervention in politics.
questions.solution_html:
• Military intervention in politics- reasons-weak democratic institutions- political instability
  • corruption- economic crises-civilian government failures- military leaders justify coups
  • claiming to restore order or national security- ethnic tensions and external influences -such
  • interventions often weaken democracy- civil liberties and constitutional governance.
questions.final_answer: interventions often weaken democracy- civil liberties and constitutional governance

questions.question: Analyse the causes and consequences of guerrilla movements in Latin / America.
questions.solution_html:
• Guerrilla movements in Latin America- emerged from social inequality- land
  • concentration- poverty- political repression- unequal distribution of wealth-groups such as
  • FARC in Colombia adopted armed struggle against state authority- movements caused
  • prolonged conflicts-displacement- economic disruption-some later entered peace negotiations
  • while violence and insecurity persisted in certain regions.
questions.final_answer: while violence and insecurity persisted in certain regions
